name: Strawberry Jam
source: All you wanted to do was try out the new pastry shop, but somehow you've found yourself in a strange new world full of... strawberries? Stranded in an unknown land with a mysterious pair of twins, you must get closer to them to learn the truth surrounding their family and the world around you.
translation: 你只是想去尝试新开的甜点店，却莫名其妙来到了一个充满……草莓的奇异新世界？你被困在未知土地上，与一对神秘双胞胎相伴。为了了解他们家族和这个世界的真相，你必须逐渐靠近他们。
